sentences.en: Bribes are something that arises in conjunction with power organizations.
sentences.zh: 贿赂是与权力机构相伴而生的现象。

sentences.en: Private companies have been working in conjunction with local communities.
sentences.zh: 私营公司一直与当地社区合作。

sentences.en: A conjunction is a word which joins words, phrases, clauses and sentences together.
sentences.zh: 连词是用来连接单词、短语、从句和句子的词语。

senses.zh: 连词 - 结合; 联合 形容词: conjunctional
